description: This file is the __init__.py for the processing package, serving as an initializer that exposes key interfaces and components (classes, functions, and variables) for easier import and usage by other modules within the project.

classes.name: BaseTranscriber
classes.description: Base class/interface for different transcription implementations.

classes.name: StubTranscriber
classes.description: A stub implementation of a transcriber, likely for testing or placeholder purposes.

classes.name: WhisperTranscriber
classes.description: A transcriber implementation possibly leveraging OpenAI's Whisper model.

classes.name: TranscriptSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of transcribed speech, including start/end times and text.

classes.name: SubtitleSyncError
classes.description: Custom error class for subtitle synchronization errors.

methods.name: process_and_sync_subtitles
methods.description: Function to process raw subtitles and synchronize them with audio/video.

methods.name: create_workdir
methods.description: Creates a working directory for processing tasks.

methods.name: rag_top_k_for_subtitles
methods.description: Retrieves top-k related items for subtitles using RAG techniques.

methods.name: retrieve_top_k_for_cue
methods.description: Retrieves top-k related cues using RAG methods.

methods.name: retrieve_top_k_for_cues
methods.description: Bulk retrieval of top-k cues for a list of cues.

methods.name: correct_cue_with_rag
methods.description: Corrects or refines a cue using RAG-based methods.

methods.name: batch_correct_cues_with_rag
methods.description: Batch correction of multiple cues using RAG techniques.

methods.name: correct_subtitles_with_llm
methods.description: Corrects subtitles using a large language model.

methods.name: apply_corrected_texts
methods.description: Applies corrected texts to subtitles or transcripts.
